<a id="legend"></a>

**Legend:** <img src="badges/waiting.svg" alt="waiting" title="Waiting" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Waiting · <img src="badges/skipped.svg" alt="skipped" title="Skipped" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Skipped · <img src="badges/running.svg" alt="running" title="Running" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Running · <img src="badges/publishing.svg" alt="publishing" title="Publishing" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Publishing · <img src="badges/failed.svg" alt="failed" title="Failed" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Failed · <img src="badges/pending.svg" alt="pending" title="Pending" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Pending · <img src="badges/superseded.svg" alt="superseded" title="Superseded" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Superseded · <img src="badges/not-built.svg" alt="not built" title="Not built" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Not&nbsp;built · <img src="badges/cancelled.svg" alt="cancelled" title="Cancelled" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Cancelled · <img src="badges/unsatisfiable.svg" alt="unsatisfiable" title="Unsatisfiable" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Unsatisfiable · <img src="badges/blocked.svg" alt="blocked" title="Blocked" width="14" height="14" align="absmiddle">&nbsp;Blocked.

Available shows the published package version without a current/outdated indicator. In build names the recorded work state and package version, or links to the immediate prerequisites it is waiting for. Waiting can be indirect and can appear before a new capture exists; Blocked identifies a stopped prerequisite. Existing Pending, Superseded, Not built, Cancelled, Skipped and Unsatisfiable states remain distinct. Completed work with no outstanding prerequisite activity appears as a centered `—`; labels are left aligned. No new package revision or job is implied by a wait. Alternative text and hover titles name every state. Build log identifies a verified source job; no link is shown until one exists. In other columns, `—` means no available package or an unrecorded fact.
